events.content:
Built the book tracker in `/workspace`. It has separate currently reading and finished shelves, an add form, and a page for each book with its title, author, and editable notes. You can mark a book finished and copy its link.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` and survive a server restart. To run it, use `npm start` and open `http://localhost:3000`. A shared book link will work for someone else when they can reach the server.

`npm run build` and `npm test` pass; the integration tests cover direct book links and persistence after a restart. Setup details are in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).

item.text:
Built the book tracker in `/workspace`. It has separate currently reading and finished shelves, an add form, and a page for each book with its title, author, and editable notes. You can mark a book finished and copy its link.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` and survive a server restart. To run it, use `npm start` and open `http://localhost:3000`. A shared book link will work for someone else when they can reach the server.

`npm run build` and `npm test` pass; the integration tests cover direct book links and persistence after a restart. Setup details are in [README.md](/workspace/README.md).
